If you are looking to purchase or sign up for **Intercom** (the customer service and AI-powered messaging platform), `you can get started directly through their official site` rather than buying boxed software or physical units.[[1]](https://www.intercom.com/pricing)

#### Intercom Plans & Pricing Structure

Intercom uses a combination of **per-seat** pricing for your team and **usage-based** pricing for AI and messaging:[[1]](https://www.intercom.com/pricing)

- **Essential Plan** : Designed for small teams needing core inbox and chat capabilities.
- **Advanced Plan** : Includes deeper workflow features, multi-team support, and free Lite seats.
- **Expert Plan** : Built for larger organizations requiring maximum automation, routing, and enterprise tools.
- **Fin AI Agent** : Available on plans at $0.99 per resolved outcome (or as a standalone AI agent for existing helpdesks).[[1]](https://www.intercom.com/pricing)

You can test out the platform with a **14-day free trial** (no credit card required) on the [Intercom Pricing Page](https://www.intercom.com/pricing).[[1]](https://www.intercom.com/pricing)

*(Note: If you meant a physical hardware intercom system for a building or home rather than the Intercom software platform, let me know so I can pull up hardware options instead!)*
